long_biography.plain_text:
An idea pursued by Carmine Saladino became Maticmind, an Italian systems-integration business. Its early strength lay in designing, installing and managing communications and IT infrastructure for public agencies and companies. Saladino remained the entrepreneurial anchor as the group broadened into cybersecurity, cloud computing, data centres and connected-infrastructure applications.

Expansion combined internal development with acquisitions. Maticmind bought specialist businesses in fibre-network engineering, cyber technologies and digital services, while new institutional shareholders supplied capital for further growth. The result was a technology platform able to cover networks, applications and operational security for clients with complex infrastructure. Saladino's role was to shape that strategy and lead the company through successive changes in ownership.
